title: CAPIT Dashboard | National Well Plugging Tracker
description: Explore plugged-well records published by CAPIT, compare state activity, and check each record's source, freshness, and revision history.
headline: National Well Plugging Dashboard
body: Filter published well-plugging records by state, source, timeframe, and record status. Every panel states its scope, data source, and freshness, so you always know what a number counts.

sections.heading: What the Dashboard Shows
sections.body: The dashboard brings public well-plugging records from many state systems into one view:
bullets: **Published Plugged-Well Records:** plugged-status records from state sources that have passed CAPIT's checks and been published.
**CAPIT Mint Activity:** tokens minted under the 1:1 rule, one for each published record.
**State Comparison:** maps and rankings of records added by state, with coverage notes.

sections.heading: Revision History and Provenance
sections.body: State agencies often revise, correct, or reclassify records. CAPIT keeps an append-only revision history instead of overwriting old data. Each published record shows its source agency, verification date, and a link to the underlying state record.

sections.heading: Definitions and Caveats
sections.body: State definitions differ. Some sources publish only orphan wells, some publish all plugged wells, and some publish partial subsets. Each panel states its scope in plain language. Dashboard figures count records CAPIT has published, which can differ from a state's own count of wells plugged.
